answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 50 slots through a single inlet, and newcomers bid bonds to enter. The top 50 lock 40 POA each, refunded only after 20 epochs of honest work. A farm wanting 1,000 fake names must outbid honest agents 1,000 times, paying 40,000 POA up front, while an honest agent pays once and gets it back. Each slot carries a ferrous seal and an ivory receipt only the bidder holds, so a resold slot cannot pass as new.
